_comment: Example run settings for the evaluators (de4sdv_broker_path_bench.run).
A run writes settings.json into its run directory with the values of that
run. The evaluators read only these keys; the new-subscription phase times
come from the relay's log, not from settings. everything else is a raw
artifact (the pcaps, the logcat, the probe JSON).
relay_logcat_tag is the relay lane's liblog tag. Its real value is the
relay's init-service name (see the README section 'Interfaces this bench
needs'); it is left as a placeholder here so this committed file does not
carry the model-guard marker while the relay lane is unmerged.
condition names which VC-MW-020 condition this run exercises: hmi_down,
ivi_vm_down, sdv_core_vm_down or pair_restart; a case pass needs all four.
